Toolbar Buttons
Add — Create a new flashcard with an image and word. Shuffle — Randomly reorder your cards. Delete — Remove the current card from the deck. Clear — Delete all cards in the current deck. Rename — Edit the word on the current card. Games — Open the game menu to play with your cards. Load — Load a saved JSON deck file. Manage — Open your saved deck library to quickly load or switch decks. More — Access Load, Save, Rename All, and Clear All options. Settings — Clip images, resize text, preview cards, toggle sound and display options.

About Save Options
📄 Quick Save (JSON)

Fast and simple • Human-readable • ~5-15MB

Best for: Quick backups, small decks (1–50 cards)

📦 Export Package (ZIP)

Smaller file size • Organized • ~3-8MB

Best for: Large decks, sharing with others

🔒 Save Over Existing File

Saving over an existing file isn't possible because of browser limits on tablets and phones. The browser can't replace a file you already saved.

This feature is only available on the app.

How to make flashcards
One picture = one card

Each picture you add becomes one flashcard. The card starts with the same name as the picture file. You can rename cards later.

Ways to add pictures

Select files — click the select icon to choose pictures from your computer.— tap the select icon to choose pictures from your device.

Drag & drop — drag picture files into the create window and drop them.

Copy & paste — copy a picture, then paste it with Ctrl+V (Windows) or ⌘V (Mac).

File types that work

JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, BMP, SVG, HEIC/HEIF (iPhone photos), and AVIF.

Size and quantity rules

You can add up to 50 pictures. Large photos are shrunk automatically so they load faster. Animated GIFs need to be 3 MB or smaller.

Deck Library
📖 How this library works

1. Import — Pick one or more JSON decks, then tap Next.

2. Organize — Browse all saved decks; rename or delete in Edit. Use Create to keep it in the default list, or Group for a folder.

3. Folders — Create folders and assign decks. Load decks from the side panel anytime.

💡 Importing does not automatically load the deck into play — use the side panel for that.
